8a0974eb45.q: Why should entrepreneurs write a book instead of trying to sell books directly?
8a0974eb45.a: The biggest mistake authors make is writing a book to sell a book versus writing a book to sell. You should write a book as a marketing tool for transformation and movement, not just to move copies. When you create a book, you have to think bigger than just selling the book itself. The book becomes a tool to get in front of audiences, secure speaking engagements, attract coaching clients, or promote a product or service. For example, one author uses her book about healthy relationships and social media to get into schools and the YMCA to speak and promote her app for neurodivergent children.

5fd239dcf3.q: How do you know if you have written the right book for your business?
5fd239dcf3.a: The way you know if you wrote the right book is if you go to an event, set it up, and people who don't know you are buying it. Most people don't care about your memoir or biography unless you're already famous. Instead, people are looking for solutions to what they're overcoming—depression, heartbreak, diabetes, workplace disrespect. You have to put yourself in the mindset of the reader and create a book that solves their problem. If you set your book down at an event and nobody is picking it up or wanting to buy it, then you need to adjust what the book is about.
